service_message:
The EON Compiler is only available for pretrained models for enterprise projects. You can either:

1. Deploy without the EON Compiler enabled (at the cost of more RAM and ROM) (use `tflite` engine, if calling from the API).
2. Train your complete project in Edge Impulse, which will give access to the EON compiler on the free and pro tier.
3. Go to https://www.edgeimpulse.com/pricing for information on our Enterprise Plan.
